intro.t: Nowadays, [[there is considerable debate about whether]] life today is better than in the past. [[Hence, I would like to present my views on]] this issue. From my point of view, modern life is significantly better due to remarkable advances in health, entertainment and communication.

There is a growing recognition that work is an essential part of modern life. In recent times, there has been considerable debate about job satisfaction versus high salaries. Therefore, it is vital we analyse the benefits and drawbacks of both options.

In recent years, protecting endangered animals has attracted increasing attention from the public and environmental experts worldwide. [[Consequently]], I intend to set out my personal view of this issue. It appears that we should do everything possible to save them for future generations.

[[It is often argued that]] relationships are essential to our happiness and wellbeing. In recent times, there has been considerable debate about the value of friendships compared with family ties. Therefore, it is vitally important to consider the advantages and disadvantages of both.

Nowadays, pollution has become an increasingly serious problem affecting the entire planet. [[It is widely recognised]] that pollution damages health and the environment significantly. [[Hence]], it is vital to explore practical solutions to the main problems and explore practical solutions.

The fashion industry has a significant and growing influence on modern society. Therefore, this essay will make clear where I stand on this issue. Because of this, [[there is considerable debate about whether]] its effects are positive or negative. I firmly believe the fashion industry creates several serious problems for people.

Learning a foreign language is becoming increasingly important in today's globalised world. [[Consequently]], I intend to set out my personal view of this issue. Because of this, many people question whether language learning offers benefits beyond passing exams. I firmly believe there are many valuable reasons to learn languages throughout life.

Learning history is an essential component of education systems worldwide. Therefore, in this essay I will explain my opinion regarding this question. Because of this, [[there is considerable debate about whether]] national history should be compulsory for all students. [[I firmly believe that]] everyone should study their own country's history thoroughly.

[[It is widely recognised]] that technology has transformed modern communication completely. [[It is often argued that]] digital communication has both positive and negative effects on social interaction. [[Hence]], it is vital to analyse the arguments on both sides.

In recent times, online shopping has grown enormously in popularity worldwide. There is a growing recognition that it has both positive and negative effects on consumers and communities. Therefore, it is vital that we analyse the pros and cons of buying products online.

In modern society, famous athletes earn extraordinarily high salaries exceeding millions annually. [[Consequently]], I intend to set out my personal view of this issue. Because of this, many people question whether such enormous payments are actually justified. I believe that many professional sports stars are paid excessively.

In recent times, self-employment has become an increasingly popular career choice for many people. [[It is often argued that]] both working independently and for employers have distinct advantages. Therefore, it is vitally important to consider the advantages and disadvantages of each option carefully.

Advertising is everywhere in modern society, appearing on television, online and in public spaces. [[Hence, I would like to present my views on]] this issue. Because of this constant presence, [[there is considerable debate about whether]] it truly benefits society. I believe that advertising often has more harmful than positive effects overall.

Helping others is fundamental to building strong, supportive communities everywhere. Therefore, this essay will make clear where I stand on this issue. Because of this, many people argue that everyone should contribute regularly to helping others. [[I firmly believe that]] helping others should be an important part of everyone's life.

[[It is common knowledge that]] physical education plays an important role in school life. [[Consequently]], I intend to set out my personal view of this issue. In recent times, there has been debate about whether sport should be compulsory for every student. It seems clear to me that all students should be required to participate.

[[These days]], children are exposed to a vast number of advertisements every day through television and social media. Therefore, in this essay I will explain my opinion regarding this question. Because of this, [[there is considerable debate about whether]] marketing aimed at young people should be permitted. It is beyond doubt that such advertising causes more harm than good and should be banned.

[[It is widely recognised]] that family structure significantly affects children's development and wellbeing. [[It is often argued that]] both large and small families have distinct advantages and disadvantages. [[Hence]], it is vital to analyse the benefits and drawbacks of each.

[[These days]], technology is advancing at a pace unimaginable to previous generations. Because of this, many debate whether these changes will ultimately improve human life. It is my sincere belief that technology will continue to improve our lives in profound ways.

Over the past few years, gap years have become increasingly popular among young people before university. [[It is common knowledge that]] taking time off from education can have both positive and negative effects. [[Consequently]], it is essential that we study the arguments in favour and against the advantages and disadvantages carefully.

[[These days]], childhood obesity has become an increasingly serious problem in many countries. [[It is often argued that]] this crisis affects children's health and future wellbeing significantly. Therefore, it is important to examine the main problems and discuss effective solutions.

In recent years, social media addiction has become a significant concern among young people. [[It is widely recognised]] that excessive use has led to serious consequences for mental health. [[Hence]], it is vital to examine the main causes and their resulting effects.

[[These days]], working from home has become increasingly common in many professions. [[There is considerable debate about whether]] remote work is actually better than traditional office work. Therefore, this essay will defend the position that arguments on both sides of this discussion.
In recent years, electric cars have become increasingly common worldwide. It appears that the rise of electric vehicles will have a profoundly positive impact on our future.

In recent times, online learning has become increasingly widespread across all educational levels. [[It is often argued that]] both online and traditional classroom learning have significant advantages. Therefore, it is vitally important to consider the advantages and disadvantages of each approach carefully.

Nowadays, millions of people keep pets as part of their daily lives. [[Hence, I would like to present my views on]] this issue. [[It is widely recognised]] that animals can significantly affect human health and happiness. [[I firmly believe that]] pets genuinely improve people's mental wellbeing.

body.t: [[I firmly believe that]] healthcare [[plays an essential role in]] improving our lives. [[This is because]] diseases that once killed millions can now be treated effectively. [[For example]], vaccines have eliminated deadly illnesses like polio and smallpox. [[As a result]], life expectancy has increased dramatically worldwide.

One positive aspect of earning a high salary is financial security and stability. [[This is because]] well-paid workers can afford comfortable lifestyles and support their families. [[For example]], they can pay for quality healthcare and education. Another strong point is that we spend nearly a third of our lives working, so earning good money makes those hours worthwhile.

To begin with, what matters most to me is that many magnificent species are currently in serious danger of extinction. This is largely because hunting and habitat destruction have reduced their numbers drastically. [[For example]], tigers, rhinos and elephants face critical threats. [[As a result]], we are losing irreplaceable wildlife at an alarming rate.

The main argument in favour of friends is that they provide enjoyment and shared interests. [[This is because]] we choose friends who share our hobbies, tastes and values. [[For example]], teenagers select friends to socialise and have fun with. [[As a result]], friendships create happiness and memorable experiences throughout life.

First of all, transport causes significant air pollution in cities worldwide. [[This is because]] millions of vehicles produce harmful emissions every single day. [[For example]], major cities suffer from dangerous levels of smog. [[As a result]], respiratory diseases are increasing among urban populations.

Firstly, to start with, I believe that pressure to look fashionable damages people's confidence and self-image. [[This is because]] advertisements constantly promote unrealistic beauty standards. [[For example]], many teenagers feel inadequate trying desperately to follow the latest trends. [[As a result]], self-esteem and body image suffer considerably among young people.

In the first place, what matters most to me is that learning a language can bring genuine pleasure and enjoyment. [[This is because]] discovering new words and expressions is intellectually stimulating and exciting. [[For example]], speaking another language while travelling creates wonderful, memorable experiences. [[As a result]], language learning becomes personally meaningful and rewarding.

To begin with, the main reason I hold this view is that history teaches us invaluable lessons from past events and mistakes. [[This is because]] understanding previous events helps societies avoid repeating serious errors. [[For example]], learning about past wars teaches younger generations the importance of peace and diplomacy. [[As a result]], students become more informed and responsible citizens.

[[The main advantage of]] technology is connecting people instantly across vast distances. [[This is because]] social media platforms allow communication with anyone worldwide. [[For example]], families can video call relatives abroad daily and share special moments. [[As a result]], maintaining relationships across distances becomes much easier.

One positive aspect of online shopping is its unmatched convenience and accessibility. [[This is because]] customers can browse and purchase products anytime from home. [[For example]], busy professionals can order items late at night after work. [[As a result]], shopping becomes far more efficient. What is more, online prices are often considerably lower.

Firstly, what matters most to me is that athletes certainly deserve fair payment for the entertainment they provide to millions. [[This is because]] major sporting events attract enormous global audiences and generate huge revenues. [[For example]], football matches and Olympic events are watched by billions worldwide. [[As a result]], athletes become extremely valuable entertainers in the modern world.

The main argument in favour of self-employment is independence and personal freedom. [[This is because]] people can choose their own working hours, projects and clients freely. [[For example]], freelancers work when they feel most productive and creative. [[As a result]], they often feel more motivated and satisfied with their careers.

To begin with, my first reason for thinking so is that advertising does keep consumers informed about available products and services. [[This is because]] companies use advertisements to communicate new offerings and special deals. [[For example]], customers learn about useful innovations and discounts through advertising campaigns. [[As a result]], making informed shopping decisions becomes somewhat easier for consumers.

For one thing, to start with, I believe that helping friends and family significantly strengthens personal relationships. [[This is because]] supporting others builds trust, respect and deeper emotional connections. [[For example]], helping a friend during difficult times brings people much closer together. [[As a result]], relationships become stronger, more reliable and more meaningful.

First of all, what matters most to me is that sport teaches essential teamwork and communication skills. [[This is because]] team games require players to cooperate and work towards shared goals. [[For example]], playing football teaches young people to communicate effectively under pressure. [[As a result]], students develop social skills that prove valuable throughout their lives.

Admittedly, the main reason I hold this view is that some advertisements aimed at children are creative and genuinely entertaining. [[This is because]] companies produce engaging content with memorable characters. [[For example]], animated adverts can be visually inventive and enjoyable to watch. [[On the other hand]], entertainment value alone cannot justify the broader harmful effects.

[[The main advantage of]] large families is that children learn valuable social skills from siblings. [[This is because]] having brothers and sisters teaches sharing, cooperation and patience naturally. [[For example]], older siblings often help and guide younger ones. [[As a result]], children become less selfish and more sociable throughout life.

To begin with, the most likely development is that technology will make global communication much easier. [[This is because]] digital tools allow people to share ideas instantly across vast distances. [[For example]], future virtual reality could allow people to attend events from anywhere on earth. [[As a result]], geographical distance will become far less significant.

One benefit of gap years is gaining valuable life experience and independence. [[This is because]] travelling and volunteering abroad develop maturity and practical skills. [[For example]], students who work overseas learn to solve problems independently. [[As a result]], they often perform better when they return to education.

First of all, unhealthy eating habits are a major cause of childhood obesity. [[This is because]] many children consume excessive amounts of sugary snacks and fast food daily. [[For example]], many eat crisps and burgers regularly instead of nutritious meals. [[As a result]], they consume far more calories than their bodies actually need.

One of the main causes of addiction is constant notifications from social media apps. [[This is because]] platforms are deliberately designed to send endless alerts about likes and messages. [[For example]], each notification triggers dopamine release in the brain. [[As a result]], users feel compelled to check their phones compulsively throughout the day.

One strong argument in favour of remote work is saving valuable commuting time. [[This is because]] travelling to offices is eliminated entirely when working from home. [[For example]], workers can save up to two hours daily that would otherwise be wasted. [[As a result]], they experience significantly less stress and physical fatigue.

To begin with, it seems probable that concern about climate change has driven interest in cleaner alternatives to petrol cars. [[This is because]] conventional vehicles produce harmful emissions contributing to global warming. [[For example]], cities where electric vehicles replaced conventional traffic have reported improved air quality. [[As a result]], the environmental case for electric cars is now widely accepted.

The main argument in favour of online learning is its exceptional flexibility and accessibility. [[This is because]] students can study anytime and anywhere with internet access. [[For example]], learners can access recorded lessons at times that suit their personal schedules. [[As a result]], education becomes more accessible to people with busy lives.

First of all, my first reason for thinking so is that companionship is one of the greatest benefits pets provide. [[This is because]] animals offer unconditional affection and a constant, comforting presence. [[For example]], elderly people living alone frequently report feeling far less isolated after getting a pet. [[As a result]], pet ownership significantly reduces feelings of depression and loneliness.

concl.t: [[All things considered]], I am convinced that life today is much better than a century ago. [[In conclusion]], improvements in health, entertainment and technology demonstrate remarkable human progress.
[[To sum up]], both money and enjoyment have clear advantages. [[On the whole]], finding work that provides both purpose and reasonable income would be the ideal solution.
[[In conclusion]], I firmly believe endangered animals must be protected urgently. [[To sum up]], conservation benefits both nature and humanity significantly.
[[On the whole]], both friends and family are extremely valuable. [[All things considered]], family support proves more reliable, but both contribute significantly to our happiness.
[[To sum up]], I believe pollution can be addressed effectively through determined action. On balance, combining cleaner transport, stricter regulations and renewable energy will protect our planet.
[[All things considered]], I firmly believe the fashion industry has damaging negative effects. [[In conclusion]], it creates pressure, encourages overspending and harms the environment badly.
[[On the whole]], I strongly believe there are many reasons to learn languages beyond exams. All in all, language learning provides pleasure, personal challenge and career advancement.
[[In conclusion]], I strongly believe national history education is essential for everyone. [[To sum up]], it provides vital lessons, important context and strengthens national identity.
[[On the whole]], technology has both significant benefits and drawbacks. [[All things considered]], it enhances communication when used responsibly alongside real-world interaction.
[[In conclusion]], both shopping methods have clear advantages. [[To sum up]], combining online convenience with supporting local shops would be ideal.

[[All things considered]], athletes work hard and entertain millions genuinely. However, excessive sponsorship earnings show they are often significantly overpaid. [[In conclusion]], salaries should be more reasonably balanced.
[[To sum up]], both employment options have significant merits and challenges. [[On the whole]], the best choice depends entirely on individual priorities, personality and circumstances.

[[In conclusion]], advertising has both positive and negative aspects. Nevertheless, manipulation and overconsumption outweigh the informational benefits significantly. [[To sum up]], advertising is not always beneficial for society.
All in all, I firmly believe everyone should regularly dedicate time to helping others. [[All things considered]], it strengthens relationships, improves communities and promotes personal growth.
[[To sum up]], I strongly believe sport should be mandatory for all students. [[On the whole]], teamwork skills, health benefits and variety of options make compulsory PE both fair and valuable.

[[All things considered]], It appears that advertising aimed at children should not be allowed. [[In conclusion]], the financial pressure, psychological manipulation and health consequences far outweigh any entertainment value.
[[To sum up]], both family sizes have significant benefits and challenges. [[On the whole]], the best size depends on each family's particular circumstances and values.

[[In conclusion]], [[It seems to me that]] technology will significantly improve human lives. [[To sum up]], better communication, safer employment and revolutionary healthcare make the technological future genuinely exciting.
[[On the whole]], gap years have both benefits and drawbacks. [[All things considered]], they benefit motivated students who plan carefully and remain committed.
[[To sum up]], childhood obesity can be addressed through determined action. On balance, combining healthier diets, more exercise and school programmes will protect children's health.
[[All things considered]], social media addiction causes serious problems for individuals. [[In conclusion]], understanding these causes is essential for addressing this growing issue effectively.
Weighing it all up, I believe working from home offers significant advantages overall. All in all, the benefits outweigh drawbacks when social needs are properly addressed.

[[In conclusion]], It is my sincere belief that the rise of electric cars will transform transport greatly. [[To sum up]], environmental necessity, supportive policies and better technology make electric vehicles the obvious future choice.

[[On the whole]], both learning methods have significant advantages and challenges. [[All things considered]], combining online flexibility with classroom interaction may prove most effective overall.

[[To sum up]], I am convinced that pets have a genuinely positive impact on mental health. [[On the whole]], the companionship, routine and stress relief they provide make animals enormously valuable.

intro.t: [[Who has never experienced a change that turned their world upside down?]] Change is one of those things we all talk about but few of us truly welcome — yet it is often the most unexpected changes that shape us the most.

[[If you could be famous for anything in the world, what would you choose?]] It's [[a question]] that tells you more about a person than almost any other — and the answer, I think, says everything about what we truly value.
[[Which piece of technology would our lives be better without?]] It's a provocative question in a world where we carry our phones like a second heartbeat — and the answer might surprise you.

[[Is there a place so beautiful, so full of life and history, that everyone deserves to see it at least once?]] For me, the answer has always been the same: Sintra, a small town tucked into the hills just outside Lisbon.

[[Why do so many students find it so difficult to stay healthy?]] Between classes, deadlines, and a social life that seems to demand its own full-time schedule, it can feel almost impossible — but a few small changes really do make all the difference.

body.t: [[For me personally]], the most significant change was moving to a new city at the age of sixteen. [[I'll never forget]] the time I walked into my new school, not knowing a single face. At first, it felt like a punishment. [[What makes it]] so special in retrospect is how much it forced me to grow — I had to make friends, navigate new streets, and discover who I was when no one already knew me.

[[One of the key things I love about]] change, looking back, is that it reveals something about your character. [[As far as I'm concerned]], it is in moments of discomfort that we find out what we are really made of.

[[As far as I'm concerned]], being famous for scientific discovery would be the greatest achievement imaginable. [[One of the key things I love about]] science is how a single idea can change millions of lives — often long after the person who had it is gone. [[If I had to choose one example, it would be]] someone like Marie Curie, celebrated not for fame itself, but for what she gave the world.

[[Apart from]] the legacy it creates, another thing that really stands out about this kind of fame is how it inspires others. [[What makes it so special is]] the ripple effect — every great scientist who becomes famous probably encourages dozens of young people to follow the same path.

[[For me personally, the best thing about]] imagining a world without social media is the mental space it would create. [[What makes it]] so concerning is how these platforms were designed to keep us scrolling — not to make us happier. [[Apart from]] the obvious distractions, [[another thing that really stands out is]] how they reshape the way we see ourselves, always comparing our private reality to someone else's curated highlight reel.

[[I'll never forget]] the time I went two weeks without Instagram while travelling. By day three, I was reading books again. By day seven, I was having conversations I'd remember. One of the key things I realised is that the technology we think we need is often the thing standing between us and the life we actually want.

[[I'll never forget]] the time I first arrived there on a grey autumn morning. [[What makes it so special is]] the way the palaces emerge from the hillside mist like something from a fairy tale — the vivid yellows and pinks of the Pena Palace against a sky full of low cloud is an image I will carry with me always.

[[For me personally, the best thing about]] Sintra is how it manages to feel both grand and intimate at the same time. You can wander through royal gardens, stumble upon hidden chapels, and stop at a small café for a warm pastry, all within an hour. [[Apart from]] its beauty, [[another thing that really stands out is]] how accessible it is — just forty minutes by train from Lisbon.

What makes the biggest difference, in my experience, is routine. One of the key things I've learned is that eating proper meals instead of relying on snacks saves both time and energy — and your brain, it turns out, works considerably better when it's been fed. If you often skip breakfast, try preparing something simple the night before. It sounds obvious, but for most students it's genuinely transformative.

[[Apart from]] diet, [[another thing that really stands out is]] the power of walking. You don't need a gym membership — walking to class, taking the stairs, or spending twenty minutes outside at lunchtime changes your mood in ways that a double espresso simply cannot match.

concl.t: [[In short, there's something truly unforgettable about]] the changes that challenge us most. Whether you love change or not, there's no denying that it [[leaves a lasting impression]] on who we become — and sometimes the biggest disruptions turn out to be the greatest gifts.

[[In short, there's something truly unforgettable about]] people who are famous for making a genuine difference. Whether you agree with my choice or not, there's no denying that lasting fame — the kind worth having — means leaving something meaningful behind long after the applause has faded.

[[It's hard to imagine life without]] our smartphones, but perhaps that's exactly the problem. [[Whether you agree or not]], there's no denying that some technologies leave a more complicated impression than their creators ever intended — and maybe it's time we decided who is really in control.

If you haven't visited Sintra yet, make sure you do — you won't regret it. [[In short, there's something truly unforgettable about]] a place that makes history feel completely alive, as if the kings and queens who once lived there have only just stepped outside.

In short, staying healthy as a student isn't about dramatic lifestyle changes or expensive wellness routines. Whether you start with sleep, food, or movement, there's no denying that small, consistent steps leave a lasting impression on how you feel — and ultimately, on how you perform.

intro.t: [[Choosing a]] documentary can be challenging because there are so many options available. However, I recently watched Our Oceans on the BBC, and I have to say it was definitely worth considering. The programme explores different parts of the ocean, from coral reefs to the deep sea, introducing viewers to fascinating marine creatures.

Choosing which concert to attend is never easy when your favourite artist is touring. However, [[when it comes to]] live performances, Ed Sheeran at Wembley Stadium was definitely worth considering. I had seen concerts on TV before, but experiencing one live was completely different.

[[Choosing a]] place for a special meal can be difficult with so many restaurants available. However, [[when it comes to]] authentic Italian cuisine, Bella Napoli [[is definitely worth]] considering. [[I visited]] last weekend to celebrate my birthday, and I have to say it exceeded all my expectations.

Choosing the right restaurant for a special occasion can be challenging. However, [[when it comes to]] celebrating important moments, The Garden Restaurant [[is definitely worth]] considering. I took my parents there for their anniversary, and I have to say it was perfect for the occasion.

Choosing the right surf camp can be challenging with so many options available. However, [[when it comes to]] learning to surf, Surf Camp Portugal [[is definitely worth]] considering. I spent a week there last summer, and I have to say it was a brilliant experience from start to finish.

Choosing the right guidebook can be challenging when planning a trip abroad. However, [[when it comes to]] travelling to Spain, Lonely Planet Spain [[is definitely worth]] considering. I used it throughout my recent trip, and I have to say it proved absolutely invaluable.

Choosing the right self-help book can be challenging with so many options available. However, [[when it comes to]] understanding how to build better habits, Atomic Habits by James Clear [[is definitely worth]] considering. A friend recommended it when I was struggling with my study routine, and I have to say it completely changed my approach.

Choosing the right language learning app can be challenging with so many available. However, [[when it comes to]] learning a new language on your phone, Duolingo [[is definitely worth]] considering. I started using it to learn Spanish three months ago, and I have to say the progress I have made has genuinely surprised me.

[[Choosing a]] film that is both entertaining and genuinely thoughtful can be harder than it sounds. However, [[when it comes to]] feel-good films with real depth, The Intern [[is definitely worth]] considering. I watched it recently expecting a simple comedy, but I have to say the main character surprised me in the best possible way.

Choosing the right video game can be challenging with thousands available. However, [[when it comes to]] relaxing yet genuinely engaging games, Stardew Valley [[is definitely worth]] considering. I downloaded it expecting to play for an hour, and I have to say I am still playing it three months later.

body.t: [[What makes this]] documentary particularly impressive is the stunning underwater photography. [[The thing that is most likely to impress you is]] how the cameras capture life in the darkest ocean zones, revealing creatures we rarely see. [[By far the best feature]] is the way complex scientific concepts are explained clearly, making the content accessible to everyone.

Known for its powerful environmental message, Our Oceans is [[regarded as]] one of the most important nature documentaries of recent years. The programme highlights the problem of plastic pollution, explaining how millions of tons end up in our oceans annually. Located at the heart of the documentary is a call to action that encourages viewers to reduce their plastic consumption.

What makes Ed Sheeran's concerts particularly impressive is that he performs alone with just his guitar and loop pedal. [[The thing that is most likely to impress you is]] how he builds complex songs layer by layer right in front of your eyes. [[By far the best feature]] is the intimate atmosphere he creates, even in a massive stadium with ninety thousand people.

Known for his emotional performances, Ed Sheeran is [[regarded as]] one of the best live performers of his generation. [[Located in]] north London, Wembley Stadium is [[famous for its]] excellent acoustics and facilities. By far one of the most memorable moments was when he played Photograph and the entire stadium sang along.

[[What makes this]] restaurant particularly impressive is its cosy, family-run atmosphere. [[The thing that is most likely to impress you is]] the genuine warmth of the staff, who make you feel like a welcomed guest. [[By far the best feature]] is the homemade pasta — I ordered the seafood linguine and it was absolutely delicious.

Known for its traditional recipes, Bella Napoli is [[regarded as]] one of the most authentic Italian restaurants in the city. Located near the old town, it remains a hidden gem that locals treasure. By far one of the most memorable moments was when the owner came to our table to share stories about his family's recipes.

[[What makes this]] restaurant particularly impressive is the elegant yet comfortable atmosphere. [[The thing that is most likely to impress you is]] the beautiful garden views through floor-to-ceiling windows, combined with soft lighting and candles on every table. [[By far the best feature]] is the modern European cuisine with seasonal menus, ensuring everything is fresh and perfectly prepared.

Known for its romantic setting, The Garden Restaurant is [[regarded as]] one of the finest dining establishments in the area. [[Located in]] a converted Victorian house, it remains intimate despite having space for larger groups. By far one of the most memorable moments was when the staff brought a complimentary dessert with a candle to mark the anniversary.

[[What makes this]] surf camp particularly impressive is the location on the Algarve coast. [[The thing that is most likely to impress you is]] the perfect waves for beginners — consistent but not too powerful. [[By far the best feature]] is the qualified instructors who are patient, encouraging and excellent at breaking techniques into manageable steps.

Known for its beautiful beaches, the Algarve is [[regarded as]] one of the best surfing destinations in Europe. Located on Portugal's southern coast, it remains warm and sunny for most of the year. By far one of the most memorable aspects was the daily lessons in small groups, ensuring everyone received personal attention.

[[What makes this]] guidebook particularly impressive is its comprehensive coverage of every region. [[The thing that is most likely to impress you is]] the detailed maps and practical transport information included throughout. [[By far the best feature]] is the honest recommendations — the writers are not afraid to tell you which attractions are overrated.

Known for its independent, traveller-focused approach, Lonely Planet is [[regarded as]] one of the most trusted travel publishers in the world. Located throughout the book are cultural insights that help you understand local customs and traditions. By far one of the most useful aspects was the practical advice on finding authentic experiences away from the tourist crowds.

[[What makes this]] book particularly impressive is its practical, science-based approach. [[The thing that is most likely to impress you is]] how Clear breaks habit formation down into four simple laws that anyone can apply. [[By far the best feature]] is the focus on small, incremental changes rather than dramatic transformations, making it feel genuinely achievable.

Known for its accessible writing style, Atomic Habits is [[regarded as]] one of the most practical self-improvement books of recent years. Located throughout the book are real-life examples and case studies that illustrate every concept. By far one of the most useful ideas was habit stacking — linking new habits to existing routines — which helped me build a consistent study schedule.

[[What makes this]] app particularly impressive is its gamification approach to language learning. [[The thing that is most likely to impress you is]] how it turns what could feel like a chore into something you actually look forward to. [[By far the best feature]] is the short lesson structure — just five to ten minutes a day is enough to make steady progress.

Known for its accessibility, Duolingo is [[regarded as]] one of the most popular language learning platforms in the world. Located entirely on your phone, it is completely free for all the core features with no hidden costs. By far one of the most useful aspects is the variety — reading, writing, listening and speaking practice are all included.

What makes Ben's character particularly impressive is how he quietly challenges every age-related stereotype. [[The thing that is most likely to impress you is]] watching this seventy-year-old intern become the most valued person in a young tech startup. [[By far the best feature]] is how he brings patience, wisdom and emotional intelligence to a workplace obsessed with speed and youth.

Known for roles that showcase quiet dignity, Robert De Niro is [[regarded as]] one of cinema's finest actors. Located at the heart of this film is a message about the value of experience and genuine human connection. By far one of the most memorable moments is when Ben solves a crisis that his younger colleagues cannot handle, simply by listening.

[[What makes this]] game particularly impressive is the remarkable freedom it gives you. [[The thing that is most likely to impress you is]] that there is no right way to play — farming, fishing, mining and building friendships are all equally valid. [[By far the best feature]] is the constant sense of progress — every day on your farm you improve, complete tasks and move closer to your goals.

Known for its charming pixel-art style, Stardew Valley is [[regarded as]] one of the finest indie games ever made. Created by a single developer over four years, it remains remarkably detailed despite its simple visual style. By far one of the most addictive aspects is the just-one-more-day feeling — there is always something to look forward to tomorrow.

concl.t: [[I would highly recommend]] this documentary to [[anyone interested in]] marine life or environmental issues. [[For anyone who]] is [[looking for]] educational content that is both beautiful and informative, [[this is a must]]. [[I can assure you that]] Our Oceans [[will leave a lasting impression on you]] and might even change your daily habits.

[[I would highly recommend]] seeing Ed Sheeran live if you get the chance. [[For anyone who is interested in]] music that combines technical skill with emotional depth, [[this is a must]]. [[I can assure you that]] his concert [[will leave a lasting impression on you]], regardless of whether you consider yourself a fan.

[[I would highly recommend]] Bella Napoli to [[anyone interested in]] genuine Italian food. [[For anyone who]] is [[looking for]] quality cooking in a welcoming atmosphere, [[this is a must]]. [[I can assure you that]] the experience will leave a lasting impression, and the prices are very reasonable for the quality offered.

[[I would highly recommend]] The Garden Restaurant for anniversaries, engagements, or milestone birthdays. [[For anyone who]] is [[looking for]] somewhere to make an occasion feel truly special, [[this is a must]]. [[I can assure you that]] the experience will leave a lasting impression, though do expect to pay premium prices for this level of quality.

[[I would highly recommend]] Surf Camp Portugal to [[anyone interested in]] learning to surf. [[For anyone who]] is [[looking for]] a well-organised sports holiday that combines activity with relaxation, [[this is a must]]. [[I can assure you that]] the experience will leave a lasting impression, and you will probably leave wanting to book another week immediately.

[[I would highly recommend]] Lonely Planet Spain to [[anyone interested in]] travelling beyond the obvious tourist destinations. [[For anyone who]] is [[looking for]] reliable, honest travel information, [[this is a must]]. [[I can assure you that]] this guidebook will significantly improve your experience and help you discover Spain properly.

[[I would highly recommend]] Atomic Habits to students and [[anyone interested in]] making positive changes to their daily life. [[For anyone who]] is [[looking for]] evidence-based advice rather than vague motivation, [[this is a must]]. [[I can assure you that]] this book will leave a lasting impression and give you strategies you will return to for years.

[[I would highly recommend]] Duolingo to [[anyone interested in]] learning a new language. [[For anyone who]] is [[looking for]] a convenient, effective way to study during commutes or spare moments, [[this is a must]]. [[I can assure you that]] consistent use will genuinely improve your language skills in a way that feels almost effortless.

[[I would highly recommend]] The Intern to anyone [[looking for]] a film that is funny, warm and actually has something to say. [[For anyone who]] is [[looking for]] something that challenges assumptions about age and the workplace, [[this is a must]]. [[I can assure you that]] it will leave a lasting impression and might even change how you think about the older people around you.

[[I would highly recommend]] Stardew Valley to anyone [[looking for]] a game that reduces stress rather than adding to it. intro.t: [[The main objective of this report is to assess]] the current school facilities. [[This report is based on]] a questionnaire conducted among over 200 students.

intro.src: Evaluation of Exchange Programme in Spain
intro.t: [[The main objective of this report is to assess]] the two-week exchange programme in Spain and recommend whether it should continue. [[This report is based on]] feedback collected from participating students after the visit.

[[The main objective of this report is to assess]] the local sports centre and suggest improvements for young users. [[This report is based on]] feedback collected from teenage members and occasional visitors.

[[The main objective of this report]] is to evaluate the recent school trip and suggest improvements for future visits. [[This report is based on]] feedback collected from students and accompanying teachers.
[[The main objective of this report is to assess]] current library services and suggest improvements. [[This report is based on]] feedback collected from students who regularly use the library.

[[The main objective of this report]] is to evaluate my recent work experience placement and recommend whether it should continue. [[This report is based on]] my daily observations and feedback from my supervisor.
[[The main objective of this report is to assess]] the school cafeteria and suggest improvements. [[This report is based on]] feedback collected from students who regularly use the service.

[[The main objective of this report]] is to evaluate the recent school environmental initiative and recommend whether similar projects should be organised in the future. [[This report is based on]] feedback collected from students and teachers involved in the project.
[[The main objective of this report is to assess]] the local youth club and suggest improvements. [[This report is based on]] feedback collected from teenage users of the club.

[[The main objective of this report]] is to evaluate the summer language course and suggest improvements for future programmes. [[This report is based on]] feedback collected from students who attended the course.

body.t: [[It is generally agreed that]] the school provides a pleasant learning environment. The classrooms are in good condition and many students [[referred to]] the new IT equipment as helpful for lessons. [[By far the best aspect of]] the facilities is the sports hall, which is modern and well-equipped.
body.t2: However, [[one major concern]] expressed by students is the overcrowded library. [[By far the worst aspect of]] the IT facilities is that machines frequently break down. The library is far from ideal since it lacks sufficient seating during exam periods. [[This is mainly due to the fact that]] student numbers have increased significantly.

body.src: Evaluation of Exchange Programme in Spain
body.t: It was generally [[felt that]] host families were welcoming and provided comfortable accommodation. Students attended regular lessons, joined group projects and took part in cultural activities. [[One positive aspect]] of the programme was the supportive attitude of teachers, who encouraged students to participate actively.
body.t2: What made the experience so valuable is that students had to communicate in Spanish every day in real-life situations. Many participants reported improved confidence, greater independence and a better understanding of Spanish culture. As a result, students became more willing to speak even when they made mistakes.

body.t: [[It is generally agreed that]] the centre offers a good range of facilities, including a gym, a swimming pool and several courts for team sports. [[One positive aspect]] of the centre is the variety of group classes, such as dance fitness and beginner training sessions.
body.t2: However, a common complaint relates to overcrowding after 5 p.m., when many students arrive. As a result, users often have to wait for machines or leave early. [[By far the worst aspect of]] the centre is the changing rooms, which are small and outdated. [[This is mainly due to the fact that]] the building has not been renovated for several years.

body.t: It was generally [[felt that]] the accommodation was comfortable and suitable for a school group. The programme included guided tours, workshops and evening activities. [[One positive aspect]] of the trip was the variety of activities, which kept students engaged throughout the stay.
body.t2: [[By far the best aspect of]] the trip was the interactive workshop, which helped students understand the topic more clearly. However, a common complaint relates to the long travel time, which caused tiredness on the first day. As a result, some students found it difficult to concentrate during afternoon activities.

body.t: [[It is generally agreed that]] the library provides a quiet and comfortable place for study. It offers a wide range of books, access to computers and space for group work. [[One positive aspect]] of the service is the helpful librarian, who supports students with research tasks.
body.t2: However, [[one major concern]] expressed by students is the limited number of seats during exam periods. [[By far the worst aspect of]] the service is the early closing time, which prevents many students from studying after school. [[This is mainly due to the fact that]] there is not enough staff to supervise longer hours.

body.t: The placement took place at a local company where I assisted staff with basic administrative tasks and customer service. It was generally [[felt that]] employees were supportive and willing to explain procedures. [[One positive aspect]] of the placement was being trusted with real responsibilities.
body.t2: What made the placement so valuable is that I developed communication and teamwork skills in a real working environment. I also learned how to manage my time more effectively. As a result, I became more confident when dealing with unfamiliar tasks.

body.t: [[It is generally agreed that]] the cafeteria offers affordable meals and friendly service. There is a daily hot meal, as well as sandwiches and snacks. [[One positive aspect]] of the cafeteria is that it saves students time during the school day.
body.t2: However, [[one major concern]] expressed by students is the long queues at lunchtime. [[By far the worst aspect of]] the cafeteria is the limited seating, which forces some students to eat quickly or stand. [[This is mainly due to the fact that]] several year groups have lunch at the same time.

body.t: The initiative included a recycling campaign, a litter-picking day and short presentations during form time. It was generally [[felt that]] student participation was high, particularly among younger year groups. [[One positive aspect]] of the project was the clear organisation of activities.
body.t2: [[By far the best aspect of]] the initiative was the increased awareness of environmental issues among students. However, [[one major concern]] expressed by participants is that some recycling bins were not emptied regularly. As a result, this discouraged students from using them correctly.

body.t: The youth club offers table tennis, board games, a small café area and occasional workshops. [[It is generally agreed that]] the club provides a safe place for teenagers to meet after school. [[One positive aspect]] of the club is the friendly and supportive staff.
body.t2: [[By far the best aspect of]] the youth club is its relaxed atmosphere, which helps young people feel comfortable. However, a common complaint relates to the limited range of activities for older teenagers. As a result, many students stop attending after the age of sixteen.

body.t: The course included daily grammar input, speaking practice and written exercises. It was generally [[felt that]] lessons were well structured and teachers were supportive. [[One positive aspect]] of the course was the regular use of pair and group work.
body.t2: What made the course so effective is that students had frequent opportunities to practise speaking. However, a common complaint relates to the course materials, which some students found repetitive. As a result, motivation decreased slightly during the second week.

concl.t: [[One key recommendation would be to]] replace outdated computers with modern equipment. [[In order to]] maximize study space, [[I would strongly recommend]] adding more library seating. [[It is essential that]] the school invests in covered outdoor areas.
concl.t2: [[Taking everything into account, it seems clear that]] these improvements would significantly enhance the learning environment for all students.

concl.src: Evaluation of Exchange Programme in Spain
concl.t: [[I would strongly recommend]] continuing the exchange programme because the educational benefits are clear. [[One key recommendation would be to]] organise more mixed-group activities after school so that visiting students spend more time together.
concl.t2: [[Taking everything into account, it seems clear that]] the programme should be offered again next year as it provides invaluable learning experiences.

concl.t: [[One key recommendation would be to]] improve the changing rooms by adding lockers and increasing cleanliness checks. [[In order to]] reduce overcrowding, [[it may be worth considering]] student-only time slots or extending opening hours on weekdays.
concl.t2: [[Taking everything into account, it seems clear that]] these changes would make the centre more attractive to young people and encourage healthier lifestyles.

concl.t: [[One key recommendation would be to]] plan an earlier departure time to reduce fatigue. [[In order to improve]] the overall experience, [[it may be worth considering]] including more free time in the evening.
concl.t2: [[Taking everything into account, it seems clear that]] the trip was successful but could be improved with better planning and timing.

concl.t: [[One key recommendation would be to]] extend opening hours twice a week during exam periods. [[In order to improve]] study conditions, [[it may be worth considering]] adding more desks and chairs.
concl.t2: [[Taking everything into account, it seems clear that]] these changes would benefit a large number of students and improve academic performance.

concl.t: [[I would strongly recommend]] continuing this placement because it provides practical experience and prepares students for future employment. [[One key recommendation would be to]] introduce a wider variety of tasks so students remain motivated.
concl.t2: [[Taking everything into account, it seems clear that]] the placement offers clear benefits and should definitely continue.

concl.t: [[One key recommendation would be to]] introduce staggered lunch times to reduce queues. [[In order to improve]] comfort, [[it may be worth considering]] adding more tables or using an additional room for seating.
concl.t2: [[Taking everything into account, it seems clear that]] these changes would improve student satisfaction and make lunchtime more enjoyable.

concl.t: [[One key recommendation would be to]] appoint a small eco-team to monitor recycling areas weekly. [[In order to]] increase motivation, [[it may be worth considering]] organising competitions between classes.
concl.t2: [[Taking everything into account, it seems clear that]] similar projects should be repeated as they raise environmental awareness effectively.

concl.t: [[One key recommendation would be to]] introduce activities aimed at older teenagers, such as music production or digital skills workshops. [[In order to]] increase participation, [[it may be worth considering]] allowing users to suggest and help organise activities.
concl.t2: [[Taking everything into account, it seems clear that]] these changes would broaden the club's appeal and attract more teenage users.

concl.t: [[One key recommendation would be to]] introduce more varied materials, such as videos, podcasts and short articles. [[In order to]] maintain interest, [[it may be worth considering]] including project work and presentations.
concl.t2: [[Taking everything into account, it seems clear that]] the course was successful but could be improved with more varied content.
